category: Usenet indexer (own Newznab fork, open registration)

free_tier.stated: Reported as 10 NZBs and 40 API hits per day with no XXX access on a free account; a second third-party listing says '2 requests/day'. The site states registration is open and shows no allowance of its own on the pages read.
free_tier.notes: The two third-party figures disagree and neither is dated; the plans page behind the sign-up was not read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file, never the payload

retention.stated: The home page states '3000+ Days Of NZB Retention' and '13+ Million Releases'.
retention.notes: documented as a vendor claim, not measured

egress.terms: No byte metering; the answer is an NZB pointer file.

interface_detail: Newznab-based indexer with a web UI; the API surface itself was not read.
tooling: A third-party listing calls it Newznab-based, so Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 add it with URL plus key; the key sits behind a sign-up.
chaining: A paid Member tier at USD 10 per year is the cheapest step up from a free allowance of a few dozen API hits a day.

limits.value: reported: 10 NZBs and 40 API hits per day on a free account; a second listing reports 2 requests per day

binding_note: The daily counters are the only numeric limit named, and they are third-party.

identity_cost.detail: The register form has username, password, confirm password and email fields, all marked mandatory; no card and no invite field is shown.

reliability_note: The home page reports a database server that failed to reboot in September 2025 and a move to new servers in November 2023; recent news posts were dated up to December 2025.
confidence_note: Registration state, retention claim and form fields are first-party; the free allowance and the prices are third-party and disagree with each other, so the record is at the third-party rung.

evidence.proved: the site claims 3000+ days of NZB retention
the register form has mandatory fields (username, password, confirm password, email)
third-party: the free account allows 10 NZBs and 40 API hits per day
third-party: the paid tiers are Member USD 10 per year, VIP USD 20 per year and Lifetime USD 50
third-party: a second listing gives the free allowance as 2 requests per day

evidence.quote: We upgraded the software on our database server. This required a reboot.
evidence.proved: the news page records a database server reboot problem in September 2025

extras.price: USD 0 (free account); USD 10 per year Member (reported)
